item.title: Kyonyuu Musume o Suimin'yaku de Nemurasete
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Jubunain
  • 発売日: 2015-05-01
  • スコア: 5.9/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 巨乳娘を睡眠薬で眠らせて
  • 英語名: Kyonyuu Musume o Suimin’yaku de Nemurasete

别名

  • Making a girl with big tits fall asleep by giving her a sleeping pill

あらすじ

A girl of some vague family relation came to visit.

She’s very obedient when my mother is watching.

But, when it’s just us, she’s an insufferable brat.

“Damn it! I’ll get back at you somehow, you little–!”
